name: bookclub
description: BookClub — запуск всей беты (mock-SENET + API + фронт) одной командой

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mock-senet install && node scripts/ensure-env.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n senet,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix mock-senet run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.beta: npm run setup && npm run dev
